extracted.name: Parmesan Spinach Balls
extracted.description: These little breaded balls of spinach and Parmesan cheese are oven-baked until golden brown. Stash unbaked balls in your freezer for unexpected guests!
ingredient_lines: 2 (10 ounce) packages frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Mix together spinach, Italian-style seasoned bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, melted butter, green onion, eggs, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl until well combined. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls. Place in a single layer on a large baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, 10 to 15 minutes.
